$description: Design tokens recovered from Arc for macOS 1.174.0 (The Browser Company). Colors come from the compiled asset catalogs (Assets.car) and are given in sRGB; 8-digit hex means #RRGGBBAA. "authoredIn" marks colors defined in another color space (converted to sRGB here). Names and numbers only: no copyrighted assets are included.

arcBlue.note: PrimaryButtonFace, Accent, Easel dark blue, ReadOnlyCreativeToolPrimary; BrandBlue is the same blue authored in Display P3 (#2F39FF after sRGB conversion)

easel.note: Sizes are Easel points; style tuples are [size, weight]. From the Easel export viewer, which states it mirrors EaselTextView.swift.

ionicons.use: Ionicons, used for sidebar custom icons (BaseModels.SidebarIconType)

springAnimationStyles.note: Numeric values are compiled into code and are not present in the type metadata.
